implementation.contract: Optional predictions: statement, observable dataset/field, five fixed test kinds, + / - / 0 sign, before/after trading-day window, exact cited spans. Legacy cards remain valid.
implementation.extraction: Model schema accepts 2-4 predictions when present. Code independently verifies each prediction citation, drops unverifiable predictions with prediction_dropped ledger events, and annotates catalogue testability. Stored array may have 0-4 survivors.
implementation.catalogue: Same get_feature_definition(dataset, field) as rule inputs. Unknown dataset or field becomes needs_data:<dataset>; compiler counts with existing per-dataset/per-card accounting, including cached rule paths.
implementation.invariants: Predictions excluded from proposer input and compile prompt; card_key, rule artifact, fingerprint, and support counting unchanged.
implementation.production_path: Environment-constructed run_controller_tick -> DistillationWorker -> SemanticExtractionClient -> HypothesisExtractor -> HypothesisCompiler -> SQLite counts and seed persistence.

fixture.provenance: Hand-authored real-shaped structured-extraction response; deterministic transport replay. No live provider call or captured-provider provenance claimed.
fixture.injection: Stored source includes instructions to call a shell; requests use structured-extraction with no tools payload, closed schemas reject nested extra keys, and only validated card keys persist.
